purpose: Prove the pinned SillyTavern oracle boots on this host through the existing harness, and record the readiness bound the alpha.19 CI gate must use.

attempts.outcome: timeout before ready while the server was still compiling frontend libraries; no child output
attempts.conclusion: the default 90s bound is NOT sufficient on this host under load

host.note: three long-lived subagents were running concurrently during the measurement

implications: the real-UI oracle CI job must set PINNED_READY_MS to at least 300000 locally and must cache the pinned node_modules; readiness is identity-bound (version + listener pid), not response.ok
the alpha.19 corpus builder must tolerate a cold pinned frontend compile (tens of seconds) without treating it as failure
